patch.summary: Homebase cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Homebase pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Basic. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Homebase plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Homebase cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Homebase against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Basic until a gated capability (payroll processing (Basic, Essentials, Plus, All-in-One)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, workforce scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Paid pricing is per location — multi-site TCO stacks faster than per-user WFM. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Small hourly businesses (retail, cafes, local services) that need scheduling + time in one app requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Paid pricing is per location — multi-site TCO stacks faster than per-user WFM
Side-by-side cost with Connecteam on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Paid pricing is per location — multi-site TCO stacks faster than per-user WFM

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Free Basic is capped at 1 location and 10 employees

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Payroll, tip manager, and hiring boosts are add-ons on every tier

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a mid-market multi-entity WFM (Deputy) or restaurant-only suite (7shifts)

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not a core HRIS or dedicated ATS

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Homebase on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model hr spend with Homebase in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Homebase alongside category cost modelling.
